releaseNotes: Added a new Equalizer tool with sound presets, graphic and parametric editing, per-output profiles, clipping protection, tray controls, and optional AutoEq headphone profiles.
Includes guided Equalizer APO setup for system-wide audio processing. The complete Windows bundle includes the official Equalizer APO installer and preserves existing configurations.
Added editor-compatible MOV downloads and an optional compatibility conversion for downloaded videos.
Added font selection to the photo editor''s Text tool.
Added a setting in General for beta features.
Made the selected highlight color control the border edge glow color.
Updated yt-dlp and bundled QuickJS-NG for current media extraction requirements.
